title: 第009章 行走的任务NPC第010章 大赛起始
lines: 片刻后，苏恒走进食堂，原以为在见到大量熟悉面孔时，会遭遇很多耻笑嘲笑，现实却出乎预料。
很多同系的女生们，见到他都是露出鼓励笑容，男生……大部分也只是眼前一亮，私下笑笑罢了，没有像于飞煌那样跑到他面前来嘲讽。
说的也是，有智商的正常人，除非彼此有恩怨或过节，才会像于飞煌和许安京那样，当着他的面那样做吧！
于飞煌，或许是觉得自己比他苏恒优秀那么多，却经常被女生们放在一起对比……觉得耻辱了才那样打击苏恒，许安京过来更是为了警告他别再耍花样？是杜欢警告后的第二次后续。
普通人面对普通同学，就算某个同学做的事有些夸张了，你心里觉得对方不自量力，也最多私下笑笑讨论下，当面羞辱人？会这么做的只是极少数。
同系的男女生是这样，不同系的，又有几个知道苏恒是谁？他们关注的还是自己系的大明帝国全明星赛、校队名额战候选人。
苏恒顺利买了一份饭菜正在用餐，就见到一道倩影从他身边路过，还偷笑着把一个纸条放在他手边。
这是罗茜？苏恒收回目光打开纸条，内容清晰可见。
“友谊第一竞赛第二，你天赋家世不如他们那么好，即便输在实战也没必要介意，加油，我相信你理论战一定行。”
苏恒有些无语，收起纸条继续用餐，片刻后又是一个妹子过来放了个纸条走了，这是王媛媛。
他只能自嘲，即便女生都是鼓励的话，也肯定他的理论学识，但在所有人心目中还是没一个看好他啊，说的也对，没有得到系统他也不可能自大到大一就报名全明星赛。
没有系统？他或许会在两三年辛苦努力后，大四在冲击一下吧？他天赋，除了没有木土火之类天赋外，也不算差，和王会、许安京等人对比，他毕竟少了几年修炼时间的。
不要忘了，苏恒在得到系统前，就有两个1级的术法，飞藤术和花神术！这是大四毕业阶段，也能在全国大学生里算优秀水准的。这是他高中三年辛苦努力的成果。
吃饱喝足离开食堂，苏恒刚想回图书馆，就见到张宏带着几个人向他走来，隔着几步张宏就笑道，“苏恒，你也报名了？好大勇气，哈哈，要不要咱们再切磋一下？让我考验下你的实力？”
苏恒眼前一亮，他真的眼睛发亮了，这不是挑衅，是行走中的任务NPC啊！
上次能得到1级木神术奖励，不就是张宏主动来送菜才达成的么？那次达成后，第二个任务就来了，足足六天苏恒还没有找到对象，无缘无故他也不好意思厚着脸皮找别人挑衅啊。
眼看再有一天完不成任务，就会面临失败，受到惩罚，苏恒还有些郁闷的。
一旦张宏再次败在自己手下，任务完成，得到新的术法或学术奖励了。
“你真有那么闲？”突然觉得张宏很可爱，苏恒也多少有些小无语的。
“这怎么叫闲？我是帮你考验下自己的实力，走，咱们去育灵园，实战，咱们看实战，这是竞赛中100分的。你缺了一条腿怎么行？反正是输，先输给我一次有个心里准备，到时候竞赛了在输掉，也不会不好意思了。”张宏得意洋洋，上次是在女神面前出风头，装逼不成反被摩擦，他一直忘不了那种郁闷和狼狈，以及女神罗茜看他的视线。
一次挑战后，张宏确定苏恒这家伙，不能让人太小视的，他上次考核还是全系五十开外，但上次到现在快两个月了，这两个月苏恒进步很大啊。
连他这个3班的第二名都在理论上输了。
还好这货有另一个大缺陷，他要向罗茜或者所有同学证明，自己不比苏恒差，一个只有理论知识的灵木师，根本不配成为完整的灵木师。
纸上谈兵有什么用？不能真正高效率培养培育灵植，没人会太重视你，除非你理论知识累积的能成为李升、许占清、朱雨那一类先贤或行业大犇，提出一个概念理论或者制定公式定理影响一代代人。
但这才是开玩笑好不好。
一段时间后，灵木系育灵园某个角落。
张宏一脸得意的指着两株相邻的特殊奔月花，对左右几个兴致勃勃围观的男生道，“看好了大家，别说我欺负人，这本就是咱们灵木系不可缺少的实践，这就是战场。”
“这两株奔月花，都是凝聚大量月灵之力，对修炼火、光、水等灵力的强者，都有不错的提升效果，但这两株都是受损的，伤势一模一样，经历超强阳光暴晒本源受损。”
“理论上，这类伤势是需要先用明光术调节光照，再施展恰到好处的变温术，记住，一定要注意时间点，治疗受损的灵植简直比烹饪一份美食难度大太多了，食物的火候若掌握不足，只是不好吃，但接受超强度太阳光照，杀伤了大量草木根源的奔月花，一个温度控制差异，明光术的各种射线调节出错，就是伤上加伤，死！”
张宏不愧是3班学霸，全系前十最有力的竞争者。
此刻对两株受伤的奔月花，他所言没有一丝错误和纰漏，就算苏恒也得承认，张宏基本功很扎实，等张宏绽放手掌，他面前奔月花阳光一下子变的暗淡，仿佛从正午跳入了月光下。那里的气温也在在稳定减弱，隔几个呼吸调低一度……
张宏得意且挑衅的看向苏恒，他知道这货没有掌握其他术法。
你理论再强有个屁用？？
“根据咱们灵木系先贤罗导提出的温变定律，还有灯塔大牛查尔斯·沃尔伯克提出的Ω>ΞЙ>∮℅℃概念，我们一定要注意光照变换下温度的切换，……”
“我们是医生，专门治疗灵植宝药受损受创的专业医生，一定不能只有理论知识，实践却……”
一边炫耀自己的学识，一边控制术法变幻，张宏再次看向苏恒，眼中充满得意的笑，下一刻他却手上一乱，两种运行中的术法直接崩盘。
一旁，苏恒根本没有管什么明光术和变温术，只是一道道充满灵秀气息的绿光打入受损的奔月花，那株奔月花以肉眼可见的速度恢复起来。
木神术，就是吊，否则不会成为所有灵木师最最最最重要术法！
“噗，这不可能，你什么时候变得这么强了？”张宏脸绿的吓人，更崩溃的想死，自己怎么又成了主动送上门被打脸，被人家按在地上摩擦的了？
来之前为了怕苏恒不承认输给自己，他还故意叫了朋友来围观，就是想让多人见证这些的，现在他又成傻逼了。
主动找苏恒挑衅，主动喊人围观，然后自己被打脸？他怎么想给自己一耳光了？！
张宏有些怀疑人生了，我一个三观正天天向上好好学习的大明帝国接班人，什么时候这么贱这么蠢了？
content_en:
A moment later, Su Heng walked into the cafeteria. He thought he would encounter a lot of ridicule when he saw a lot of familiar faces, but the reality was unexpected.
Many girls from the same department showed encouraging smiles when they saw him. Most of the boys just smiled in front of him and smiled in private. They did not run up to him to ridicule him like Yu Feihuang did.
That's right. Normal people with intelligence would do what Yu Feihuang and Xu Anjing did in front of him unless they had grudges or festivals with each other!
Yu Feihuang, maybe because he felt that he was so much better than Su Heng, but he was often compared with him by girls... He felt humiliated, so he hit Su Heng like that. Did Xu Anjing come here to warn him to stop playing tricks? This is the second follow-up after Du Huan's warning.
When ordinary people face ordinary classmates, even if something a certain classmate does is a bit exaggerated, and you feel in your heart that the other person is overestimating his own capabilities, you can only laugh and discuss it in private, or humiliate him in person? Only a handful will do this.
Boys and girls from the same department are like this. How many of the boys and girls from different departments know who Su Heng is? What they are paying attention to is their own department's candidates for the Ming Empire All-Star Game and the school team quota competition.
Su Heng successfully bought a meal and was eating when he saw a beautiful figure passing by him and snickeringly putting a note in his hand.
Is this Rosie? Su Heng withdrew his gaze and opened the note, the contents clearly visible.
"Friendship first, competition second. Your talent and family background are not as good as theirs. Even if you lose in actual combat, there is no need to mind. Come on, I believe you can do theoretical combat."
Su Heng was speechless, put away the note and continued to eat. After a while, another girl came over and left a note. This was Wang Yuanyuan.
He could only laugh at himself. Even though the girls were encouraging and affirmed his theoretical knowledge, no one thought highly of him. He was right. He wouldn't have been arrogant enough to sign up for the All-Star Game in his freshman year without getting the system.
No system? Maybe after two or three years of hard work, he will have an impact in his senior year? Apart from his lack of talents such as wood, earth, and fire, his talent is not bad. Compared with Wang Hui, Xu Anjing, and others, he has lost a few years of training time after all.
Don't forget, before Su Heng got the system, he had two level 1 spells, Flying Vine Technique and Flower God Technique! This is the senior year graduation stage, and it can be considered an excellent level among college students in the country. This is the result of his three years of hard work in high school.
After eating and drinking, Su Heng left the cafeteria. Just as he was about to go back to the library, he saw Zhang Hong walking towards him with a few people. After a few steps, Zhang Hong smiled and said, "Su Heng, you also signed up? How brave, haha. Do you want us to compete again? Let me test your strength?"
Su Heng's eyes lit up. His eyes really lit up. This was not a provocation, it was a walking mission NPC!
The last time I was able to get the level 1 wood magic reward, wasn't it because Zhang Hong took the initiative to deliver food? After completing that mission, the second mission came. Su Heng still hadn't found a partner for six days, and he was too embarrassed to provoke others for no reason.
Seeing that if he fails to complete the task one day, he will face failure and be punished, Su Heng is still a little depressed.
Once Zhang Hong is defeated by himself again, the mission is completed and he will receive new spells or academic rewards.
"Do you really have that much free time?" Suddenly he felt that Zhang Hong was very cute, and Su Heng was somewhat speechless.
"What do you mean by idleness? I'm here to help you test your own strength. Come on, let's go to the Yuling Garden for a real battle. Let's watch the real battle. This is a 100-point score in the competition. How can you do it if you're missing a leg? You're losing anyway, so be sure to lose to me once. "Be prepared, I won't be embarrassed if I lose the competition." Zhang Hong was proud. Last time he was trying to show off in front of the goddess, but he failed to show off and was rubbed. He has never forgotten the depression and embarrassment, as well as the way the goddess Luo Qian looked at him.
After a challenge, Zhang Hong determined that Su Heng should not be underestimated. The last time he took the assessment, he was still above fifty in the entire department, but it has been almost two months since the last time. Su Heng has made great progress in the past two months.
Even he, the second place in Class 3, lost theoretically.
Fortunately, this guy has another big flaw. He wants to prove to Luo Qian or all his classmates that he is no worse than Su Heng. A spiritual wood master with only theoretical knowledge is not worthy of becoming a complete spiritual wood master.
What's the use of talking on paper? If you cannot truly cultivate and cultivate spiritual plants efficiently, no one will take you seriously unless you accumulate theoretical knowledge and become a sage or industry leader like Li Sheng, Xu Zhanqing, and Zhu Yu. You can propose a concept theory or formulate a formula theorem to influence generations.
But this is a joke, okay?
………………
After a while, there was a corner of the Spirit Tree Yuling Garden.
Zhang Hong pointed to two adjacent special moonflowers with a proud look on his face, and said to the boys on the left and right who were watching with interest, "Look at everyone, don't say I'm bullying others. This is an indispensable practice for our spiritual tree system. This is the battlefield."
"Both of these two Moon Flowers condense a large amount of moon spirit power, and have a good effect on improving those who practice fire, light, water and other spiritual powers. However, both of them are damaged. The injuries are exactly the same. They have been damaged by strong sunlight exposure."
"Theoretically, this type of injury requires first adjusting the light with the Bright Light Technique, and then using the right Temperature Changing Technique. Remember, you must pay attention to the time. It is much more difficult to treat damaged spiritual plants than cooking a delicious meal. If the heat of the food is not controlled enough, it just won't taste good, but it receives super-intensity sunlight and kills a large number of Moonflowers at the roots of grass and trees. A temperature control difference, and the various rays of the Bright Light Technique are adjusted incorrectly, will add injury to injury, and death!"
…………
Zhang Hong is worthy of being the top student in Class 3 and the most powerful competitor in the top ten in the entire department.
At this moment, there was no mistake or omission in what he said about the two injured Moonflowers. Even Su Heng had to admit that Zhang Hong's basic skills were very solid. When Zhang Hong opened his palm, the sunlight of the Moonflower in front of him suddenly dimmed, as if it had jumped into the moonlight from noon. The temperature there is also steadily weakening, lowering one degree every few breaths...
Zhang Hong looked at Su Heng proudly and provocatively. He knew that this guy didn't master any other techniques.
No matter how strong your theory is, it’s useless? ?
"According to the law of temperature change proposed by our spiritual tree sage Luo Dao, as well as the concept of Ω>ΞЙ>∮℅℃ proposed by lighthouse expert Charles Walbeck, we must pay attention to the temperature switching under light changes..."
"We are doctors, professional doctors who specialize in treating damaged and injured spiritual plants. We must not only have theoretical knowledge but practice..."
While showing off his knowledge and controlling the changes in spells, Zhang Hong looked at Su Heng again, with a proud smile in his eyes. The next moment, his hands were in a mess, and the two running spells collapsed.
On the side, Su Heng didn't care about the Bright Light Technique and Temperature Changing Technique at all. He just blasted the damaged Moonflower with green light full of spiritual aura, and the Moonflower recovered at a speed visible to the naked eye.
The divine wood technique is nothing but hanging, otherwise it would not become the most important technique among all spiritual wood masters!
"Pfft, this is impossible. When did you become so strong?" Zhang Hong's face was frighteningly green, and he even more collapsed and wanted to die. How could he be the one who was sent to the door and was slapped in the face, and was pressed to the ground and rubbed?
Before coming here, in order to be afraid that Su Heng would not admit that he lost to him, he deliberately called his friends to watch, just to let many people witness this. Now he has become an idiot again.
Take the initiative to provoke Su Heng, take the initiative to call people to watch, and then get slapped in the face? Why did he want to slap himself? !
Zhang Hong has some doubts about life. I, a successor of the Ming Empire who has a positive outlook on life and studies hard every day, when did I become so cheap and stupid?
title_en: Chapter 009 The Walking Mission NPC Chapter 010 The Start of the Competition
